description: Update a Feed API schedule's name, trigger hour/day, start/end dates or schemaVersion. eBay validates the fields against the schedule's current template and returns 204. Schedules exist only for LMS_ORDER_REPORT, which requires sell.fulfillment.

schedule.description: UpdateUserScheduleRequest body; include every field the template requires

preferredTriggerDayOfMonth.description: Day of month, 1-31, for monthly schedules; days past the end of the month use the last day

preferredTriggerDayOfWeek.description: DayOfWeekEnum for weekly schedules: MONDAY ... SUNDAY; available as the template allows

preferredTriggerHour.description: Two-digit UTC trigger hour, 00Z-23Z, e.g. 11Z; available as the template allows

scheduleEndDate.description: UTC end timestamp after scheduleStartDate; the schedule then becomes INACTIVE

scheduleStartDate.description: UTC start timestamp, yyyy-MM-ddTHH:00:00.000Z; available as the template allows

schemaVersion.description: Schema version of the report, when the template requires it

scheduleId.description: Feed schedule ID, from ebay_create_feed_schedule or a list

name: ebay_update_feed_schedule
